gaps.category: Mobile-phone SIM and telecom agents, internet cafes and online-game outlets: subscriber registration and biometric re-verification (Decree 49/2017, Circular 08/2024/TT-BTTTT, Decree 147/2024)

gaps.why: Millions of small sellers on Facebook, TikTok Shop and own sites face notification/registration and ID-verification duties under a new law with a transition deadline; no state-tool coverage was checked. Excluded K07-K12 were tax, this is the distinct MOIT duty.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: New trigger: Decree 283/2026/NĐ-CP (admin penalties, labour/social insurance), effective 10/9/2026 per press (baolaocai, cafef, thuvienphapluat topic page; full decree text not read). Household employers must (a) sign written contract, even for hourly help (caution, then 1-3m VND if repeated), (b) notify commune/ward People's Committee when hiring and when ending a domestic worker (1-3m VND), (c) pay the social/health insurance sum on top of wages (10-15m VND per one source), (d) not hold ID papers (10-15m per CafeF; sources disagree). Form, method and deadline of the commune notification not found. No compliance software or agency tool seen. Buyers are households (tiny ARPU) or domestic-helper agencies. See candidate C01.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Nothing new. Scrap trading is not a listed conditional business under the Investment Law per advisory sites; no ledger or report duty for domestic scrap collectors found (only business registration and a 'no activity at the registered premises' pledge). The 80%-of-capacity cap from 1/1/2025 applies to scrap importers/users, not small dealers. No candidate.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnbroking is already K04/K21 (ANTT conditional trade under Decree 96/2016 as amended by Decree 58/2026; commune police now issue certificates for pawn, karaoke, massage, small lodging, per one source). No separate second-hand goods register found for used phones/motorbikes/cars; used-vehicle transfer changed with Circular 37/2026/TT-BCA from 8/6/2026 (electronic registration via VNeID) but that is a police registration, not a dealer register. Nothing new beyond K04/K21.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K01/K11 (not re-searched per rules).

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No operating national rule for end-of-life vehicle dismantlers found; only a draft requiring service centres to hand end-of-life vehicles to dismantling facilities declared compliant under environment law. Market is described as lacking legal facilities. Too early/undefined. Mentioned as unverified candidate C09.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Circular 04/2024/TT-BNNPTNT: breeding cattle/pigs leaving a province need ear-tag or other marking; quarantine certificate forms use personal ID number; Circulars 25/2016 and 28/2025/TT-BNNMT apply. Nothing new beyond K22 (free national MAE/VNPT database).

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Cục Thú y figure (per Saigon Times, undated): 24,600+ small-scale slaughter points, only about 7,400 with business registration, about 17,200 (70%+) unlicensed; 433 centralised slaughterhouses. Governing rules: Law on Veterinary 2015, Circular 09/2016 as amended by 10/2022 and 15/2024/TT-BNNPTNT (effective 6/1/2025); veterinary hygiene certificate required. No software seen and buyers are tiny and informal. See C04.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Circular 15/2022/TT-BNNPTNT governs vet hygiene/food safety supervision of honey for export (beekeeping, purchasing, processing sites). EU rules: only establishments on the EU list can export honey since 29/11/2024 (registered on TRACES); blended-honey origin labelling from 14/6/2026 per a secondary source. No domestic beekeeper register found. Exporter-side only; see C08 (unverified).

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Veterinary drug retailers need a vet-drug trading eligibility certificate (Decree 35/2016 as amended by 123/2018; Circular 13/2016), practising certificate holder, stock ledgers and cold-chain thermometer logs for vaccines. From 1/1/2026 prophylactic antibiotic use in livestock is banned and antibiotics are to be used only on a vet prescription (press; final legal text and retailer record/report duty NOT found). Vendor competition: MISA eShop and Sapo both publish vet-drug shop POS pages (batch/expiry/credit tracking); no prescription/antibiotic-ledger product seen. See C03.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Water Resources Law 2023 (effective 1/7/2024), Decree 54/2024/NĐ-CP (drilling practice licence, declaration, registration, permits), Circular 22/2024/TT-BTNMT (well backfilling). From 1/7/2026 households drawing groundwater for domestic use must declare at the commune People's Committee (luatvietnam, sggp, luatminhkhue); no fee for domestic use; household-specific form number and deadline not confirmed. Drilling contractors need a drilling practice licence. Buyers are households or small drillers; see C06 (weak).

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Nothing usable. Environmental permit authority moved to provincial level from 1/7/2025 (Decree 05/2025 amending 08/2022); no septic-hauler-specific register or report found. Only vendor adverts. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Lifts and boilers are strict-safety equipment under the OSH Law 2015; need periodic inspection (lifts reportedly 3-year cycle per an old source), declaration to the Labour/Home Affairs department within 30 days of use, technical file; fines 1-2m VND for no declaration and 5-10m VND for missing technical file (Decree 12/2022). Circular 19/2025/TT-BNV on inspection service pricing/characteristics effective 1/12/2025. Owners are mostly buildings/factories, not quiet micro-firms; inspection bodies sell the service. Weak candidate C07.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: QCVN 01-1:2024/BYT (Circular 52/2024/TT-BYT) replaces QCVN 01-1:2018 and applies from 1/7/2025; testing must be done by ISO 17025 accredited labs; external inspection by CDC/district health centres is stated for suppliers with 500+ households or 1,000+ m3/day (old rule), so small stations may be outside it. Annual report duty for small stations not confirmed. Candidate C05 (weak, unverified).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K05 (not re-searched).

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Reports now go to Sở Nội vụ (Home Affairs) rather than the Labour Dept from 1/7/2025 (Decree 129/2025/NĐ-CP, per accounting-advice site); labour-leasing firms file half-year leasing reports (Decree 145/2020 as amended by 35/2022 and 10/2024). Licensed firms are few hundred and not 'quiet'; no periodic-report requirement for overseas-labour agencies found. C10 (weak).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Governed by Decree 23/2016/NĐ-CP (consolidated 27/2/2026, last amended by Decree 14/2026). Cemetery records duty in Art. 16 not read. No new 2024-2026 rule or register. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Social/charity funds under Decree 93/2019 and Circular 4/2020/TT-BNV: annual report to licensing authority, finance authority and sector authority; public disclosure of contributions by 31 March; amending decree under draft (status unknown); 3,158 funds at Dec 2023. Small, mostly provincial; no halal/kosher register seen. C11 (weak).

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Decree 158/2024/NĐ-CP (from 1/1/2025) road transport; Decree 151/2024 requires GPS on commercial vehicles; later Decree 319/2026/NĐ-CP (effective 1/7/2027 per one source) adds driver-camera duties (cars under 8 seats from 1/1/2028; 8-29 seats cabin camera from 1/1/2030; sources disagree on dates). Hardware/telematics vendors dominate (see K23 pattern). Weak C12.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Market fee rules are provincial and old; no new 2026 e-collection rule found. Gold shops and FX points are covered by K01 and the SBV licensing; household tax declaration is K07-K12 (rejected). Nothing new.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: (a) Tattoo/filler/liposuction/body-art services now fall under ANTT conditional trades via Decree 58/2026/NĐ-CP (amending Decree 96/2016), effective 15/3/2026; transition period for existing premises not found; also a separate Health Dept notification and certified training for tattoo artists. See C02. (b) Independent nurseries/kindergartens: Circular 49/2021/TT-BGDĐT, consolidated 07/2026/VBHN-BGDĐT, amended by Circular 51/2026; approval by commune committee; many nursery software vendors exist; weak C13. (c) Small food producers: Decree 46/2026/NĐ-CP was SUSPENDED by Resolution 15/2026/NQ-CP (6/4/2026) until the amended Food Safety Law takes effect; Decree 15/2018 stays in force; see C14 (rejected). (d) Driving schools: K23. (e) Hunting outfitters: not applicable (no commercial hunting trade in Vietnam).

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Retail fuel stations must issue an e-invoice per sale and transmit it to tax (PM dispatch 26/CD-TTg 26/3/2024; Decree 123/2020). Pump-connected e-invoice software is already sold: PetroPos, ACMan, MISA, xcyber, einvoice.vn; Lao Cai reports 90/90 stations done. HCMC tax is building direct pump links. LPG nothing new beyond K04. See candidate 'Fuel-station pump-to-e-invoice' (rejected).

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Rice-export traders report stock monthly before the 5th to MOIT, the provincial Sở Công Thương and VFA (Decree 01/2025, Circular 35/2025/TT-BCT, replacing the weekly report). Traders need big storage and mills, so they are not tiny. EUDR for coffee is K18. See candidate 'Rice-export stock report' (weak).

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: People's Credit Funds (QTDND) face Circular 62/2025/TT-NHNN on internal control, effective 1/1/2027 (training-class source, not read in full). Co-opBank already supplies its CFeAM app to the funds. No law-driven software gap confirmed. Law on Co-operatives 2023 detail not reached. See candidate 'QTDND internal-control kit' (unverified).

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: E-prescribing: other prescribing facilities (private clinics presumably) must prescribe electronically by 1/1/2027 under Circular 26/2025/TT-BYT per an lsvn article on a draft; VnEconomy quotes 1/1/2026, so the date is contested. Decree 90/2026/NĐ-CP (effective 15/5/2026) sets fines up to 200m VND and 1-24 month suspension. Over 30,000 private facilities are said to be barely connected. Nothing new beyond K19/K20 on the software side. See candidate (weak, related to K19).

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Pharmacies: nothing new beyond K20. Chemicals: new Chemicals Law 2025 and Decree 24/2026/NĐ-CP (chemical lists); the older annual chemical-activity report was due by 15 Feb (source is a form article, not the law). Not verified whether the 2025 law keeps it or sets size thresholds. See candidate (unverified).

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Decree 290/2026/NĐ-CP amends Decree 06/2013 on in-house guards: police run training and issue certificates. The periodic police report duty for security companies under Decree 96/2016 could not be confirmed. See candidate (unverified, score 2).

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Decree 212/2026/NĐ-CP (effective 1/7/2026) drops organisational capability certificates; firms self-publish capability on csdlhdxd.gov.vn, a free state portal; practice certificates become electronic with an ID code. Hộ kinh doanh coverage unclear. Quarries: Law on Geology and Minerals 2024 (from 1/7/2025); a MAE draft circular proposes weighbridge plus smart-camera and logbooks, still a draft; Binh Dinh has 50 weighbridges. Two weak candidates.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Real-estate brokers, exchanges and consultants carry AML duties. Decree 339/2026/NĐ-CP, effective 26/8, adds fines of 40-80m VND for not reporting suspicious or large transactions, plus 1-3 month suspension. Hanoi Construction Dept urged compliance; a Directive 34/CT-TTg (11/9/2026) on AML is cited by a doanhnghiephoinhap.vn article. The ministry earlier asked for cash-transaction reports at 300m VND (threshold unverified). No dedicated Vietnamese product found. Notaries and lawyers were not searched. See candidate (promising).

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Stay notification is covered by the Ministry of Public Security's ASM software (free, linked to the population database, VNeID login, QR scan of chip ID) and VNeID, under Art. 30 Law on Residence; Decree 282/2025 fines. Tourism Law amendment (38 of 78 articles) is still before the National Assembly (Oct 2026); Decree 348/2025 penalties apply from 15/2/2026. Nothing new beyond K04. Landlord side is a separate candidate (cat 31).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Planting-area (MSVT) and packing-facility codes: Decree 38/2026/NĐ-CP, Resolution 36/2026/NQ-CP (31/7/2026) shifts to self-declaration and post-checks; data held centrally by MAE; VINAFRUIT warns that shared codes put all households at risk. Existing tools: farmdiary.online (Son La: 205 codes), OMFARM/OMFOOD, VNPT Green, national cultivation database. Fish: see cat 32. Nothing new beyond K02/K03/K18 except a cooperative-side candidate.

coverage.category: 31. Landlords of boarding houses (nhà trọ) and mini-apartments: fire safety, insurance, residence notification
coverage.found: Decree 105/2025/NĐ-CP (effective 1/7/2025) widens compulsory fire/explosion insurance to boarding houses and similar premises; Directive 19/CT-TTg: non-compliant mini-apartments and boarding houses stop operating from 30/3/2025; landlords also must notify stays. Candidate listed (weak).

coverage.category: 32. Fishing-vessel owners: electronic catch logbook (eCDT) and VMS (EU IUU yellow-card)
coverage.found: 52,872 vessels of 6 m or more in eCDT at 25/3/2026; eCDT data about 70% complete; 2,098 vessels lost VMS signal for 6+ hours; Deputy PM asked for an e-logbook circular in Jan 2026 with a mandatory date (issue not confirmed). eCDT is a free state system; EU re-inspection in March 2026 still found gaps. Candidate listed (weak).

coverage.category: 33. Plantation-code (MSVT) and packing-facility holders: cooperatives and farmer groups
coverage.found: See cat 30 and candidate. Free or provincial tools already exist.

coverage.category: 34. Small food producers and sellers: traceability record-keeping
coverage.found: Circular 63/2026/TT-BCT (MOIT, dated 30/9/2026, effective 15/11/2026, replacing 11/2026/TT-BCT) requires traceability records producible within 24 hours, kept at least 12 months after expiry or 60 months from production; no small-household exemption mentioned (VCCI/WTO-centre summary, not the circular text). Law on Food Safety rewrite is only in the 2026 legislative programme; draft Decree amending 15/2018 defines small household producers. Candidate listed.

coverage.category: 35. Private tutoring and extra-class centres
coverage.found: Circular 29/2024/TT-BGDĐT (effective 14/2/2025): off-school tutoring needs business registration and public disclosure; Ninh Binh requires 6-monthly and yearly reports (province-specific); MOET is consulting on an amendment (lsvn 18/3/2026). No software mandate found. Candidate listed (weak).

coverage.category: 36. Employers of foreign workers (small firms)
coverage.found: Decree 219/2025 folds the demand justification into the work-permit file; online via the national public service portal, 10 working days. No SME-specific or periodic duty confirmed. Generic HR-services territory. Candidate listed (weak).

coverage.category: 37. Small polluters: environmental registration, annual environmental report and hazardous-waste source owners
coverage.found: Decree 05/2025/NĐ-CP amends Decree 08/2022; Decree 48/2026/NĐ-CP (effective 29/1/2026) amends again. Facilities that need an environmental registration file annual report form 05.B; waste producers register as hazardous-waste source owners. Thresholds under the new decrees were not checked. Candidate listed (unverified).

coverage.category: 38. Spas and aesthetic services
coverage.found: Under Decree 96/2023 any invasive aesthetic service must run as a licensed clinic; non-invasive ones notify the provincial health department. Enforcement news is from 2022-2023. Nothing new in 2026 found. No candidate.
